title: “Do not merely listen to the word, and so deceive yourselves. Do what it says.”
paragraphs:
“Do not merely listen to the word, and so deceive yourselves. Do what it says.”
— James 1:22

Information doesn’t transform you.
Submission does.

Many people are full of revelation
but empty of change.

Delayed obedience often disguises itself as
“waiting on God” —
when God is waiting on us.

Ask yourself today:
What was the last thing God told me to do… that I haven’t done yet?
